title: Asset-specific parameter tuning for ETHUSDT with EMA Trend Gate
objective: Test whether ETH-specific parameter tuning improves EMA Trend Gate performance on ETHUSDT, addressing the observed 50% performance gap vs BTC (0.489 vs 0.998 Sharpe)
hypothesis: ETH exhibits different volatility and mean-reversion characteristics than BTC. By optimizing EMA Trend Gate parameters specifically for ETH, we expect to improve OOS Sharpe from 0.489 toward 0.7+, addressing the cross-asset generalization gap observed in prior runs.
strategy_rationale: This directly follows the contradiction in lessons: EMA Trend Gate achieves 0.998 on BTC but only 0.489 on ETH with identical parameters. Rather than assuming the strategy doesn't generalize, we test whether asset-specific tuning closes the gap. This avoids prematurely concluding the strategy is asset-specific when parameter optimization might resolve the issue.
dataset_requirements: ETHUSDT 1h OHLCV data with deep history (2018-present preferred)

historical_depth_requirement.target: Multi-year (3+ years minimum to match BTC analysis window)
historical_depth_requirement.justification: ETH has deep liquid history since 2017 on Binance. Using 3+ years matches prior BTC WFA window and ensures statistically meaningful OOS evaluation across 80+ windows.

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing deep ETH dataset available in workspace/data/. Fresh fetch only if coverage gaps exist.

scope_selection_rationale: ETHUSDT is the natural follow-up to prior ETH run (RUN-20260403123516-uhaq6t). Using the same instrument ensures clean comparison. The 1h with 4h regime filter timeframe is the proven effective configuration from prior runs.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv exists in workspace/data/ with multi-year history

implementation_steps: 1. Verify ETH deep data exists and has sufficient history (3+ years)
2. Create ETH-specific strategy config with expanded optimization ranges
3. Run full WFA with Optuna optimization on ETHUSDT
4. Compare optimized ETH metrics vs prior unoptimized ETH run
5. Compare optimized ETH metrics vs BTC baseline

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: Full WFA completed with at least 60 windows and 500+ total trades

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA fails due to data issues, fall back to using the standard ETH data and re-run
If optimization fails to improve ETH, document the persistent gap as evidence for asset-specific strategy requirements
notes: This experiment directly addresses the 'Consider asset-specific parameter tuning for ETH vs BTC' backlog item
Success criteria: ETH optimized Sharpe ≥ 0.7 (significant improvement from 0.489)
If ETH cannot reach 0.7 with optimization, this confirms asset-specific behavior rather than parameter mismatch
The 0.7 threshold is conservative - BTC achieved 0.998, but ETH may have structural limits
